explanation: f'(x)=3x^2-12x+12=3(x-2)^2. The derivative is positive on both sides of x=2, so the stationary point is neither a local minimum nor a local maximum. The function has no local extrema.

answers.correct_value: The function $f(x)$ has no local extrema
answers.wrong_value: There is a local minimum at $x=2$
